system.description:
Your hands know exactly where to press, what to whisper, what the wound actually needs — every restorative working you cast or brew does that much more. Healing spells and brewed potions restore an additional +1 HP per die, and once per day you may cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without expending a slot.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
